proposed_fix.description: Conditionally investigate and mitigate node-level network and connection bottlenecks affecting inbound traffic to currencyservice.
steps: [Human Approval Required] Review node network error counters and conntrack table utilization; if conntrack is near capacity, temporarily migrate currencyservice pods to nodes with lower connection counts.
[Human Approval Required] If network receive errors are elevated, temporarily increase the TX queue length on affected nodes and monitor latency improvement.
[Human Approval Required] If latency persists, temporarily spread currencyservice pods across additional node pools to distribute inbound connection load.
preconditions: Verify current inbound latency metrics and confirm no active deployments or rollouts are in progress.
Check node network error counters and conntrack table utilization for nodes hosting currencyservice pods.
Document current node configurations and pod scheduling policies to ensure safe rollback capability.
proposed_fix.rollback: Revert node network and TX queue configurations to defaults, migrate pods back to their original nodes, and restore original conntrack limits if modified.
